in_marathi.name: Sachidanand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Happiness that comes from within
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sachidanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sachidanand is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Sachi (true) and Danand (happiness). It denotes the happiness that comes from within and is not dependent on external factors.
